original_metadata.title: Full equivariant KR-theory ring of a compact connected simply-connected Lie group with Lie-group involution and conjugation action
original_metadata.author: Chi-Kwong Fok
original_metadata.source_title: The Real K-Theory of Compact Lie Groups
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The proof combines a Real equivariant formality spectral-sequence comparison with a classification of Real, Quaternionic and paired complex generators. Its new Weyl-denominator and universal-unitary injectivity arguments recover integral generator squares, including two-primary torsion that disappears after inverting2; the result is substantially stronger than an additive module computation.

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Complete Section4 author proof chain through Theorem4.33 read: formality Theorem4.5, equivariant lifts Lemma4.7, square-zero complex-pair generators Proposition4.13, real/quaternionic unitary representation modules, full torus/Weyl-cover injectivity and universal generator-square computation. The quoted earlier Seymour module/lift construction, Hodgkin/Brylinski-Zhang complex K-theory and standard KR coefficient/realification identities are published background; their exact definitions and statements are bundled. Quaternionic universal square calculation is the author-described analogous calculation after its separate injectivity and coefficient model are proved. The theorem includes the full mixed complex-type case with r-generator degree conditions and signs determined by Proposition2.29, not an exterior-algebra simplification. Neither nonequivariant applications nor inverted-two variants are counted.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Theorem4.33 for compact connected simply-connected Real Lie group(G,sigma_G), with sigma_G a Lie-group involution and G acting on itself by conjugation. The graded equivariant KR ring is described over KR_G-star(pt), including all Real/Quaternionic/complex-pair generators and the stated square and coefficient relations. No general compact non-simply-connected group or torsion-free/exterior simplification asserted.
original_metadata.editorial_warning: The source itself corrects the earlier Brylinski-Zhang definition of delta_G in Definition2.5 and explicitly discusses that author correction in Remark2.8 and Proposition4.31. This packet uses the current published definition and proof conventions; no collector-supplied homotopy or map correction is introduced.
original_metadata.source_boundary_note: The full original equivariant KR-ring Theorem 4.33 is retained as one simultaneous main problem unit with all required definitions, standard coefficient and prior module statements, and the complete Section 4 new proof chain. This includes formality, equivariant lifts, complex-pair square-zero generators, real and quaternionic unitary representation modules, torus and Weyl-cover injectivity, universal square computations and all mixed-type generator degree and sign conditions. The short closing paragraph assembles this genuinely new core; it is not treated as a routine final-corollary task. Earlier Seymour/Hodgkin/Brylinski-Zhang and KR realification identities remain cited established background. The current paper author correction to delta_G is preserved exactly. No nonequivariant application, inverted-two version or exterior-algebra simplification is selected.
